description: Get test results for a target. Returns test runs with pass/fail counts and individual test cases.

analysis.description: Set to "true" to include flaky test indicators

build.description: Filter by build name. Do not combine with run.

cases.description: Set to "false" to exclude individual test cases and return only run-level summary data

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response

limit.description: Number of test runs to return. Defaults to 1 (latest run only).

persistent.description: Set to "true" to include associated bugs and cost data

run.description: Filter by run id. Do not combine with build.

target.description: The target id. Use tesults_get_targets to retrieve target ids.

name: tesults_get_results
